period_note: SOLO basis, this bank's own real Q1 2024 interim financial statement (clean native text extraction). Balance sheet is the 31-Mar-2024 snapshot; comparative Dec-31-2023 total assets (217,992,816,405) matches the existing 2023_Q4.json exactly. Cross-checked against the FY2024 annual report's own retrospective 'Quarterly Performance (Standalone)' table: every single line item matches to the cent or a trivial rounding difference (Net Interest Income 825.85 exact, Operating Profit 967.23 exact, Total Provision 401.43 exact, Tax Effect 230.35 exact, Net profit 335.44 vs table's 335.45). NOTE: this same FY2024 annual report also contains a SECOND table (printed on the immediately following page, also labelled '(STANDALONE)') with materially different Q1,2024 figures (Net Interest Income 851.38, Net profit 366.09) -- given the exact match to this real interim filing shown above, and given that second table's own operating-profit gap vs this one (approx. 125m) is close to the bank's own disclosed subsidiary operating profit for the year (126.28m, from the same annual report's 'NRBC Bank Securities Ltd Financial Position' panel), that second table is almost certainly the CONSOLIDATED figure mislabelled 'Standalone' in the original report -- a report-production error, not a data discrepancy in this filing. Recorded in sources.json; not used here. non_interest_income here EXCLUDES investment_income (they are separate line items in this quarter's real interim statement), matching the Q4/annual files' definition of non_interest_income -- NOT the broader bundled definition used in this dataset's table-only years (2014-2019), which folds investment income into 'non_interest_income'.
